title: Application Insights Overview
description: Understand Application Insights and how it provides deep application performance monitoring.

data.text: Application Insights is an Application Performance Management (APM) service that extends Azure Monitor. It automatically collects telemetry about your application availability, performance, and usage without requiring you to change your code significantly.

terms.definition: A credential that tells your app where to send telemetry data.
The Application Insights library installed in your app to capture telemetry.
A feature that captures debug snapshots when exceptions occur in production.
A real-time dashboard showing live request rates, failure rates, and performance counters.

data.title: Create an Application Insights Resource (Azure CLI)
data.code:
az monitor app-insights component create \
  --resource-group myResourceGroup \
  --app myAppInsights \
  --location eastus \
  --workspace $(az monitor log-analytics workspace show -g myResourceGroup -n myWorkspace --query id -o tsv)

data.title: Auto-Collected Telemetry
items: Request rates, response times, and failure rates.
Dependency rates, response times, and failures (database calls, REST APIs).
Exceptions with stack traces and environment details.
Page views and user session counts.
Custom events, metrics, and traces you add manually.

data.caption: Application Insights telemetry flow
data.definition:
graph TD
    App[Your Application] --> SDK[App Insights SDK]
    SDK --> AI[Application Insights]
    AI --> LA[Log Analytics Workspace]
    AI --> AM[Azure Monitor]
    LA --> PORTAL[Azure Portal]
    AM --> PORTAL
    PORTAL --> DASH[Dashboards]
    PORTAL --> ALERT[Alerts]
    PORTAL --> SNAP[Snapshot Debugger]

data.title: Start with Auto-Instrumentation
data.text: For .NET, Java, Node.js, and Python, Application Insights offers auto-instrumentation agents that collect telemetry without code changes. Start there, then add custom telemetry for business-critical events.

data.title: Explore Application Insights in the Portal
data.description: Familiarize yourself with the Application Insights experience in Azure Portal.
steps: Navigate to the Overview blade and identify request rate, failure rate, and average response time.
Open Live Metrics Stream and note the real-time charts.
Check the Failures blade for any sampled exceptions.
data.expectedOutcome: You can navigate the Application Insights portal and identify key telemetry areas.
